The finding: journal 2245 (period 8, closed) has DR 6631.24 on account 5300 and CR 6622.24 on account 2000. The invoice amount is 6622.24, so the credit to AP control (2000) is correct and the expense debit (5300) is overstated by 9.00. The fix should reduce the 5300 debit by 9.00.

Constraints:
- Period 8 is closed, so the correction must go in an open period (11 or 12). I'll use period 11.
- The original journal is unchanged; the correction journal must balance by itself, so a one-sided 9.00 line on 5300 can't stand alone. The original plus correction group must balance: original DR-CR on 5300 is +6631.24; correcting with CR 9.00 on 5300 makes the group balance with the total net of expense at 6622.24, matching AP. Net effect: 5300 = 6622.24 DR, 2000 = 6622.24 CR, which is correct.
- The correction journal itself has a one-sided 9.00 credit to 5300. The task notes a mistyped amount may be corrected with a one-sided line, so this is permitted.
- No invoice status change: this is an unbalanced_journal finding, not a duplicate, so invoice 757 stays P.
